column1: # Sieve training corpus: Project Gutenberg selections, as packaged by NLTK (public-domain texts).
# Fetch and check with: python3 tools/fetch_corpus.py
# Fields (tab-separated): file, encoding (utf-8 or latin-1), role (train or test), sha256.
# Training reads the "train" files in this order, each canonicalised with canon-text-v2 and
# joined by one SPACE. The "test" files are held out: sieve measure reports bits per character
# on them, so the figure is not flattered by text the model has already seen.
